newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel continues climb with NYMEX, diffs firm.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel continues climb with NYMEX, diffs firm.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices continued their rally on Thursday, adding nearly two and a half cents to Wednesday's three cent move thanks in part to slightly firmer differentials both in the Gulf Coast and New York Harbor.
Skyrocketing futures prices, helped by unexpected distillate draws in the weekly API and EIA inventory reports, accounted for most of the upswing.
Diffs on aviation-quality 54-grade firmed to between 2.50 and 2.75 cents above the print, while offers in the Gulf advanced to about even with December NYMEX, traders said.

"A little stuff is trading here and there," a New York buyer said, adding the market was not greatly swayed by Wednesday API data showing a 1.3 million barrel draw on total jet fuel stocks for the week ending Nov 8.
Traders noted that total U.S. stocks remained at comfortable levels of 39.4 million barrels, about 1.5 million higher than the comparable period last year.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632
